plaatsen.tekst: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo the Ahohite, one of the three mighty men with David, when they defied the Philistines that were there gathered together to battle, and the men of Israel were gone away:
Zalmon the Ahohite, Maharai the Netophathite,
And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
